mentions.name: Adaptation Engine for cohenhallowell.com
mentions.description: An adaptation engine for cohenhallowell.com that takes in any study or learning material (epub, images, audio, lecture notes, etc.) and uses a series of AI models to create multimodal, interactive learning experiences adapted for 7 types of neurodivergent learners.
mentions.audience: Neurodivergent learners (ADHD, dyslexia, ASD, dysgraphia, etc.)
mentions.source_excerpt:
I am on the last miles before releasing a public version of an adaptation engine for cohenhallowell.com.

Essentially, its a platform that takes in any study or learning material (epub, images, audio, lecture notes, etc) and it uses a series of AI models to create multimodal and interactive learning experiences adapted for 7 types of neurodivergent learners (adhd, dyslexia, asd, dysgraphia, etc..)
